name: connector
title: Connector
description: Shared-element morph. One id on two routes and the browser flies one into the other. No dependencies.
docs:
Give the same id to an element on two routes:

  // app/gallery/page.tsx
  <Connector id={`tile-${item.id}`}><Thumb /></Connector>

  // app/gallery/[id]/page.tsx
  <Connector id={`tile-${item.id}`}><Hero /></Connector>

The browser morphs one into the other. Ids must be unique per page, and
Connector takes exactly one child element.
